SRAVYA BOBBALI Principal Software Engineer

Result-driven Principal Full Stack Engineer with 7+ years of experience owning solutions end-to-end — from design and architecture through development, deployment, and production at scale. Proven track record leading engineering teams, driving technical decisions, removing delivery blockers, and using AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering speed and quality.

Mobile: +91-9502829805 Email: sravyareddybobbali27@gmail.com

PROFILE SUMMARY

Principal Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience taking full ownership of enterprise Full Stack and cloud solutions — from design and architecture through development, deployment, and production at scale.

Leads engineering teams end-to-end: driving technical decisions across architecture, APIs, databases, and integrations, and removing technical blockers to keep delivery on track.

Deep hands-on expertise in Node.js, NestJS, React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, REST APIs, GraphQL, AWS, and MySQL/MongoDB, applied to building secure, high-performance, production-grade applications.

Owns performance, scalability, and security outcomes across applications by embedding optimized architectures, IAM systems, and engineering best practices into delivery.

Actively uses AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude AI) to accelerate engineering delivery and improve code quality.

Proven ability to lead technical discussions, mentor and guide engineering teams, and act as the primary technical point of contact with clients and stakeholders — translating business needs into realistic, well-engineered delivery.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Technical Delivery Ownership • Engineering Team Leadership & Mentoring • Solution Architecture & System Design • Performance Tuning & Optimization • Agile Delivery & Sprint Ownership • Stakeholder Engagement & Client Management • System Integration • Quality Assurance & Production Readiness • Security Protocols & Compliance • AI-Assisted Engineering Productivity

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Backend & APIs: Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, GraphQL, RESTful APIs, SOAP APIs, TypeScript, JavaScript • Frontend: React.js, HTML5, CSS3, Apollo Client • Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Jenkins, CI/CD Pipelines, Git, Bitbucket • Databases & Search: MySQL, MongoDB, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash) • Messaging & Caching: Apache Kafka, Hazelcast • AI & Productivity Tools: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude AI • Domain Expertise: Utility Billing, Customer Self-Service Portals, Enterprise Applications

WORK EXPERIENCE

Abjayon Consulting Pvt. Ltd., Hyderabad | June 2019 – Present

Principal Software Engineer | Sep 2025 – Present • Own end-to-end technical delivery of scalable enterprise applications — from architecture and design through development,

deployment, and production — using Node.js, NestJS, React.js, AWS, and modern databases.

Drive technical decisions across architecture, APIs, databases, and integrations, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and production-ready.

Act as the primary technical point of contact with clients and stakeholders, translating business requirements into realistic, well- engineered delivery plans.

Lead and mentor an 8-member engineering team through technical reviews, solution guidance, and hands-on troubleshooting of critical issues — removing blockers to keep delivery on track.

• Drive application performance, scalability, and security across the stack through optimized architecture and engineering best

practices.

Partner with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, and production releases, taking ownership of delivery at scale.

Adopt AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude AI) across the team to improve engineering speed and code quality.

Senior Software Engineer | Sep 2024 – Sep 2025 • Owned production rollout of a core enterprise product end-to-end, coordinating delivery across multiple cross-functional teams. • Established coding standards and code review practices to raise software quality and delivery consistency. • Led design of scalable technical solutions in close partnership with product and business teams. • Partnered with DevOps for stable, efficient production deployments, taking ownership of issues through to resolution. Full Stack Developer | Sep 2022 – Sep 2024 • Delivered enterprise features end-to-end using React.js, Node.js, and NestJS. • Improved backend performance and optimized application responsiveness. Implemented secure authentication and third-party API integrations for enterprise services.

• Followed SDLC and Agile best practices throughout development, taking ownership of features from requirements to release. Consultant – Full Stack Developer | Jun 2019 – Sep 2022 • Developed responsive front-end modules and scalable backend services using Node.js and Express.js. • Supported testing, deployments, and production issue resolution, maintaining high system availability. SIGNIFICANT ACCOMPLISHMENTS

Owned end-to-end production deployment of a large-scale enterprise application, from architecture through go-live. • • Delivered multiple secure third-party integrations as technical owner. • Established engineering best practices that improved code quality and delivery efficiency across the team. • Led delivery of enterprise applications supporting 200,000+ users.

Improved application performance and scalability through architecture optimization and hands-on technical leadership.

PROJECT

AI Trading Bot • Designed and led development of an AI-powered automated trading platform using Next.js and the Angel One API for real-time

market analysis and automated order execution.

EDUCATION

2019 | B.Tech. | Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE) | Vignan Institute of Technology & Science (Affiliated to Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University) | Hyderabad, Telangana

PERSONAL DETAILS

Address: Hyderabad – 500089 Date of Birth: 27th August 1998 Languages Known: English, Hindi & Telugu
